takes.text: Rồi Tí bất chợt im lặng. Một chiếc áo dài màu xanh thiên thanh xuất hiện trên màn hình. Cậu nhớ đến bà.
takes.style: Scene: Late at night, alone at his desk under a lamp. The mood turns still and tender as Tí sees a sky-blue áo dài and thinks of his grandmother. Speaker: the storyteller of this film, a warm Vietnamese man around forty; calm, unhurried, intimate, never theatrical. Delivery: Quieter, slower, the mood suddenly turns still. Then: Soft and tender, almost a whisper of memory. Then: Very soft and slow, full of feeling, a gentle pause before "bà". Speak Vietnamese with a natural Northern accent. Leave a short natural pause between sentences.
